ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 80% low-intensity pixels (black/dark grey) vs 20% high-intensity pixels (white), concentrated at the distal tips and scattered in internal mottling.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant black contiguous region in the medial and proximal areas. Symmetrical high-intensity white patches at the far distal tips. Sparse white mottling and circular pixel clusters distributed across the lower central lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch at the central convergence point with a distinct depth ratio relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular peaks and valleys along the entire trailing edge. Significant jagged indentations visible on the upper right lobe boundary; left lobe presents a more consistent but still serrated topography.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Broadly convex sweep trajectory with a slight terminal upward flare at the distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of circular white pixel groups (barnacle attachment scars) visible on the upper left tip and scattered throughout the central dark pigmented areas.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of white, non-parallel linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing the dark pigment, particularly dense on the right lobe and central lower region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear rake marks and possible tissue loss/irregularities on the right trailing edge indicating past physical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique circular 'eye' pattern (white ring with dark center) located on the upper-most edge of the left distal tip.
